name: training-fit-diagnostic-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Measure whether fixed final policies approach matched holding even on a fitted-period window before assuming development failure is overfitting or spending on another algorithm.
interpretation: Both training benchmark failures and a training-pass/development-fail contrast are descriptive; periods have different regimes and durations, so neither proves an optimizer/capacity/generalization cause. PPO initialization/source differ; do not rank algorithms causally.
constraints: No fitting, optimizer calls, normalization updates, sampling by future outcome, checkpoint selection, provider requests or Colab allocation
No retired-test access or promotion; preserve original failed development gates
Read only existing training bars/features and saved development reports; source hashes/normalizer/tensors/update counts unchanged
All26 declared symbols; next-session fills, costs, four actions, holding limits and causal execution state unchanged
Compact group/per-symbol metrics and complete derived paths retained outside Git; diagnose, do not select a winner
